name: Metamorphose Love or Fake <Jou>
original_name: メタモルフォーゼ Love or Fake<上>
source:
Akira Kinouchi was a totally, totally average male student.
For a certain reason he ran away from home and was now living secretly inside his school.
So, not totally average. But other than that, totally, totally average. 

Then a fairy sprite popped out of his smartphone and turned him into a girl with girlish desires. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107304.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
木之内晃是一个非常非常普通的男学生。
由于某种原因离家出走，现在秘密住在学校里。
所以，并不完全平均。但除此之外，完全非常平均。

然后，一个精灵从他的智能手机中弹出，把他变成了一个有着少女欲望的女孩。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107304.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
